title: Android thread crash when joystick connection changes (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.1-stable, and a custom build of 4.5.1 with Vulkan Mobile fixes cherry-picked: https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/releases/tag/4.5.1.stable%2Bvulkan_mobile_fixes.
- Discovered through Google Play crash reports, this isn't something I can reproduce myself.

### System information

Redmi Note 11 (Android 13), Redmi Note 12 Pro (Android 14), Poco M5 (Android 14)

### Issue description

[Rift Riff](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adriaandejongh.riftriff&hl=en-US) got a few crash reports on Google Play with the following stacktraces:
